@laravel/passkeys 0.2.0 declares MIT and ships no licence text anywhere this build could measure.

What was measured, in the sitting of 2026-10-18:

- the registry tarball at version 0.2.0 carries a README.md and a package.json and no licence
  file in any shape the staging pass reads
- the repository laravel/passkeys at the publishing commit
  c76a758bd4a72360fc72de053f7146158cd57d4b carries no licence entry in its whole tree
- the repository at tag v0.2.0 carries no licence entry in its whole tree either

This file is the tracked record of that measured absence. The pass stages the package's
declaration with no text behind it, which is the row the page already renders honestly. Nothing
here invented a text. If this publisher ever ships one, put the real text at LICENSE beside this
marker and delete the marker, and the next build carries the text.
